label: GO after an unrewarded rare a1 trial (a1 -> S2, no reward), only in the last ~10 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only in episode trials 90-99 (none earlier). Every activation has prev_reward 0, and about 92% of the mass comes after a1 -> S2 rare transitions (prev_action 1, prev_common 0), the case where the model-based answer is to stay with a1. The agent always picks a1 (model_act 1, choice logit > 2.8, value in the lowest bin). Strongest when there are several unrewarded rare a1 trials in a row near the episode end, mostly with S1 good. It never fires at D1/D2, after rewarded trials, or on a2 choices. The same history without the late-episode condition gives precision 0.015, so the feature mostly tracks the episode clock or the low end-of-episode value. With ep_trial>=90 recall is 0.92 but precision is 0.16. Tightening to >=95 gives F1 0.44 and mass recall 0.84 on dev. Using value<4 instead of the clock scores about the same (F1 0.46). The recorded predicate uses only observed history plus the episode position; no future variables.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S2 u, ?) and trial before (GO: a1 S2 u, a1 S1 r); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0, phase=D1 & ep_dec=0.
